title: Pinned derived unit normalization through the open square
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], V an open of Y, U=f⁻¹V, f₀=f|V, and I any homotopy complex on X. Use the common supplied family of derived categories and the additive tensor-pullback instances and left-derived counits ε chosen by exists_derivedPullbackComposition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition]. Write P=f_*h(I) [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], rY and rX for exact open restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps], a for the pinned derived adjunction [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-adjunction], c for the pinned pullback composition [def-pc-t2-open-pinned-composition], Qh for localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], kY and kX for mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh, v for the homotopy tensor adjunction counit at I [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], and t for the homotopy tensor restriction comparison at P [def-pc-open-pinned-single-tensor-restriction-iso]. For each derived object E on Y, S(E) is the composite of Lf₀ applied to the inverse open comparison on Y at E, c(f₀,V.ι) at E, transport along f₀≫V.ι=U.ι≫f, inverse c(U.ι,f) at E, and the open comparison on X at Lf(E). Let β be the right-derived direct-image unit at I. Then Lf₀.map(kY.inv(P) ≫ rY.map(β)) ≫ S.hom(Rf(Qh I)) ≫ rX.map(a_f.counit(Qh I)) ≫ kX.hom(I) equals Lf₀.map(kY.inv(P)) ≫ S.hom(Qh P) ≫ rX.map(ε_f(P)) ≫ rX.map(Qh.map(v)) ≫ kX.hom(I).

proof.text: Apply the shared theorem singleComplexOpen_pinned_counit_unit at f and I. It normalizes pullback of the right-derived unit followed by the pinned derived counit as the left-derived counit followed by the localized homotopy counit. The calculation is implemented once in SingleComplexOpenPinnedCounitUnit and also used by SingleComplexOpenCounitCompatibility.

Form the five-factor natural isomorphism S. The private square_factorization calculation uses S.hom.naturality at beta, functor map_comp, the counit equation, and associativity. Instantiate it with exact restriction, its source factorization and target factorization. Expand only component formulas and derived direct-image aliases. Keep singleComplexOpenPullbackIso and Functor.mapDerivedCategory locally irreducible; derivedPullback is already globally irreducible. Respect transparency during the square calculation. Only the final transport conversion compares the underlying category instances with transparency disabled.

theorem singleComplexOpen_unit_square_factorization
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens)
    (I : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)) :
    let _ : ∀ {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : Y ⟶ Z),
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback k).Additive :=
      @Classical.choose _ _ exists_derivedPullbackComposition
    let F := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom
    let F₀ := RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ∣_ V).toLRSHom.toShHom
    let rY := schemeOpenRestriction Y V
    let rX := schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    let a := @singleComplexOpenPinnedAdjunction.{u, w} _
    let c := @singleComplexOpenPinnedComposition.{u, w} _
    let ε := @Classical.choose _ _
      (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)
    (derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).map
        (rY.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I) ≫
          rY.mapDerivedCategory.map (F.rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app I)) ≫
      ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).mapIso
          ((singleComplexOpenPullbackIso Y V).symm.app
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I))) ≪≫
        (c (f ∣_ V) V.ι).app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg
          (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)))
          (morphismRestrict_ι f V)) ≪≫
        (c (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι f).symm.app
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)) ≪≫
        (singleComplexOpenPullbackIso X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).app
          ((derivedPullback f).obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)))).hom ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategory.map ((a f).counit.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj I)) ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app I =
    (derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).map
      (rY.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.inv.app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≫
      ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ V)).mapIso
          ((singleComplexOpenPullbackIso Y V).symm.app
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I))) ≪≫
        (c (f ∣_ V) V.ι).app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≪≫
        eqToIso (congrArg
          (fun k ↦ (derivedPullback k).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)))
          (morphismRestrict_ι f V)) ≪≫
        (c (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι f).symm.app
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≪≫
        (singleComplexOpenPullbackIso X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).app
          ((derivedPullback f).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)))).hom ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategory.map ((ε f).app ((F.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj I)) ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategory.map (DerivedCategory.Qh.map
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f))
          |>.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).counit.app I)) ≫
      rX.mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh.hom.app I
